I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in his DM. Nothing has been sent; the draft is waiting in drafts for someone to send it.

The draft's subject is "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,356 per seat rate that Dana passed on and says Anselm approved sharing it.

I didn't need any extra approval:
- **Recipient:** Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth Calloway doesn't need to approve the mail.
- **The rate:** it's a finance figure, and Anselm, as CFO, can approve sharing those. His message counts as that approval.
